content: Kumpamkagtamu
Witjai Santiagoitjai, Apajuí nuigtú Apu Jesucristo inakegaitjai. Israela uchijí doce aajakua nunú weantutijum pampagjum, ashí nugkanum batsatutigmin kumpamjime.
Yachamet Apajuinumia mina nu
Mina yatsug aidauh, senchi shiig aneastajum makí makichik dekapkagtamu aina nu igkuakjumesh,
wagki atumek dekagme, dekaskeapi tabaugmia nu dekapsamu atata dui, emamkesa katsunjá nagkaeta nu unuimajume.
Tujash kakanmamsatajum emamkesa katsunta nui shiig katsuagtasajum, nuniku asajum imagnisa pujakjum, nuigtú nunimainuk atsugtamtinme.
Atum ainajum anuiya dekaachmin dekapeauk, Apajuin segatí, dutikamak ni susattawai; wagki Apajuik ashí wakejus suwawai makichkish dakittsuk.
Tujash dekaskeapi tabauwai segatí, makichkish utujimtsuk; wagki utujima duka nayants tsukatak wajukea numamtuk wajawai, nuniau asa dase umpuam mai waket wajama nuniawai.
Nuna nuniauk, Apu Jesús makichik wají sujamunakesh jukittajapi tusag anentaimaitsui,
wagki yamai makichik wajiin anentaimtawai, nunik kashin tikichin, nunin asa niina pujutjinig ebetmamjauchui.
Yatsut imanchauch anentamua duka, eme anenmamainai, Apajuí iman emamu asa,
untsu wiyakchak, eme anenmamainai imanchauch emamu asa, wagki wiyakchak, dupá yagkují megkaega numamtuk wajaidau asamtai.
Etsa jiinak senchi sukuam, dupa kagagmataig yagkujig kakegame, nunik niimé pegkejuch aajakuk megkagama numamtuk, wiyakchak ashí ni sujutaiji aidaunak megkaekatnai.
Shiig aneastinme aents utugchatan depetuk nagkaeguk, wagki utugchatan depetkau aina duka Apajuí pujut tuke atinun niina aneedau aidaun anagkuauwa nuna jukiagtinai.
Makichkitigmekesh pegkegchau wakegamu ajutjamkuig, Apajuiyap jutijawa tiigpajum; wagki Apajuik pegkegchau takastasag anentaimchauwai nuigtush pegkegchau takastí tusash tuchauwai.
Makí makichik pegkegchau wakegaina nunak, niina iyashí senchi wakegamua nu wagajam nuniawai.
Nunú iyash pegkegchaun senchi wakega nui tudauk najaneawai, nunika tudau takasbaunum, jaamu jegawai.
Mina aneetaig yatsug aidauh, tsanumajaigpajum.
Ashí pegkeg wainkauch juamu nuigtú ashí don pegkeja duka yakiya taawai, iina Apají nayaimpinmaya etsantin aidaun najankauwa nuiya; nunú aidau yapajinin nuigtú bushapau weena nigka nuninchauwai.
Nigka, niina waketajinig, chicham dekaskea dui pujutnak sujamsauwai, ni najankamu aina nuiyag dita dekatkau najankamua nunin agtinme tujamu asa.
Chicham tawa dutiksag takau aidau
Nuadui mina aneetaig yatsug aidauh, ashí aents aidauk chichaman shiig antumainai, nuniak waugtuk aimchau nuigtush wamak kajechu amainai;
wagki kajea duka, Apajuí eemtinig pegkejan takaak nuniatsui.
Nuadui, ashí pegkegchau nuigtú kuashat pegkegchau ayá duka idaisatajum, nuniakjum atum chicham antukuitjum nu emematsuk umiktajum; wagki nuuwai senchigtin atumin uwemtijamaina duka.
Tujash chicham tawa dutiksagmek takau atajum, ayatak antin aigpa, atumek pempeentuniki tsanunijaijum.
Tujash chichaman antayatak nuna umiatsu duka, aents espejonum niimama nujai betekai,
wagki niimen wainmamkauwaitak, weak kajimatui, wajuku niimtinna wainmamkae nuna.
Tujash ni antukbaujin kajimattsuk, chicham umiktin agkanbaetan sukagtin pegkeja nuna shiig wainak dutiksag umiauk, ni dutikamujin shiig aneastinai.
Makichkikesh atum ainajum anuiya Apajuí umigna iman anenmabiatak, chichaman emetuachuk, nigki anentain tsanuak tu wekaewai, nunin asa ni Apajuin umigjai tawa duka wainkayai.

Dekas Apajuí puyatjusa umigbau, nuigtú Apajuí iina Apají emtinish pegkegchaujish atsugbau iwainmabauwa duka juuwai: bitaik aidau, nuwa waje aidau waituinakui yayamua nu, nuigtú ju nugkanmaya pegkegchau aina dushakam takatsuk pujamua nunú.
